geo_basis: country; both payment companies are South Korean per ZDNet Korea; no city stated
date_note: Day KIS says the abnormal access happened (NHN KCP: 17 November); the article, published 24 November, gives no disclosure day.
title: KIS Information & Telecommunication and NHN KCP report abnormal access that leaked data, ZDNet Korea says
summary: ZDNet Korea reports that KIS Information & Telecommunication said abnormal access on 18 November to its VAN business-support web server leaked 862 records (208 customers, 654 employees), and that it cannot technically identify which individuals. NHN KCP said abnormal access to its customer inquiry service on 17 November leaked 160 sales receipts and that it has notified everyone concerned. The article names no attacker.
plain: ZDNet Korea reports two Korean payment companies said abnormal access leaked data: 862 records at KIS Information & Telecommunication and 160 sales receipts at NHN KCP.
exec: Two Korean payment firms say abnormal access leaked data: 862 records at KIS Information & Telecommunication and 160 sales receipts at NHN KCP, per ZDNet Korea.
action: No action needed; for awareness. NHN KCP says it has notified everyone concerned.

evidence.quote: KIS정보통신에서도 지난 18일 밴(VAN) 업무지원 웹 서비스 서버에 비정상적으로 접근해 고객 208건과 임직원 654건 등 총 862건의 정보 유출이 있음을 밝혔다.

validation.note: One publisher read (ZDNet Korea), relaying the companies' own statements; the companies' notices were not read and no second outlet was found.

review.note: Compared 18 Nov, 862 (208+654), 160 receipts, 17 Nov NHN KCP, notification and no-attacker against ZDNet Korea; possible-duplicate flag is false (different companies than Welcome Payments)
